elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI is required to provide assistance for at least 90 days, but no six-month assistance period is provided.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not specify any rates or charges for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must export and deliver all Company Content, user information, and other Company data within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No standard machine-readable format is required.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no deletion or deletion-certification obligation.
